en.headline: Three women arrested after brawl at Mong Kok nail salon
en.dek: Police held three women on suspicion of fighting in a public place after a confrontation at Argyle Centre; one jewellery shop worker was injured.
body: Police arrested three women after a fight broke out at a nail salon in Mong Kok on Sunday evening.

Officers were called at about 6.30pm to a first-floor salon at Argyle Centre. They detained three women on suspicion of fighting in a public place. A 49-year-old jewellery shop staff member, surnamed Chan, reported injuries and was taken to Kwong Wah Hospital. Two nail technicians, aged 50 and 39, were taken to a police station for further investigation.

Video circulating online showed a short-haired woman being held and having her hair pulled, with someone appearing to strike her head with a hard object. Bystanders urged those involved to stop. Reports said the confrontation followed a long-running dispute between staff from neighbouring shops and that the jewellery shop worker had spat at someone inside the salon. Mong Kok District Crime Squad is investigating.

zh.headline: 旺角中心美甲店打鬥 警拘3名女子
zh.dek: 周日傍晚旺角中心一間美甲店發生打鬥，警方以涉嫌在公眾地方打鬥拘捕3名女子，其中一人受傷送院。
body: 旺角中心一間美甲店周日傍晚發生打鬥，三名女子被捕。
警方今日約6時半接報，指亞皆老街旺角中心商場1樓一間美甲店有人打交。警員到場後，以涉嫌「在公眾地方打鬥」拘3名女子。其中49歲姓陳首飾店職員報稱受傷，由救護車送廣華醫院治理；另50歲及39歲美甲師則被帶返警署調查。
網上流傳影片顯示，一名短髮女子被從後拘住並拉扯頭髮，有人以硬物插向其頭部。在場人士大叫停手並呼籲報警。消息指事件源自相鄰舖舖人員長期糾紛，首飾店職員曾走入美甲店向人吐口水引發衝突。旺角警區刑事調查隊正調查。
